messages.subject: DEB model
parts:
Hello everyone, 
I’m really sorry to disturb you! I’m a graduate student from China. I’m very interested in the dynamic energy budget (DEB) model of organisms. The species I’m studying is the marbled rockfish (Sebastiscus marmoratus). I’ve been searching online for methods to construct the DEB model of this species. I found the “add my pet” website and tried to obtain the DEB model parameters for the marbled rockfish from it. However, my foundation in this area is too weak, and I can’t understand a lot of the content. I’d like to ask if anyone can help me obtain the relevant parameters for the marbled rockfish. If someone can help me, I’d be happy to pay some fees, as long as the constructed model is authentic.My gmail is“xuexiang...@gmail.com”，welcome everyone‘s reply.
Best everyone
